toegepas.rede_vinder: 'binne-in' says plainly that the wood was inside the rhino; bare 'binne' at the end of the clause reads clipped.
toegepas.fout: Bare 'binne' at the end of the clause is clipped and can read as 'indoors' rather than 'inside the rhino'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'binne-in' says plainly that the wood was inside the figure, with the same claim and nothing added.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The gold becomes an object through working, so 'word' fits better than 'wees'.
toegepas.fout: 'kan wees' describes a state where the sentence is about gold becoming an object through working.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'kan word' is the exact verb for the change the sentence describes, and the meaning stays the same.

toegepas.rede_vinder: As a pronoun meaning 'each one', the standard written form is 'elkeen', one word.
toegepas.fout: The pronoun meaning 'each one' is written as one word, 'elkeen'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: This is a plain spelling fix that adds no count and leaves the protected 'Een van hierdie voorwerpe' sentence untouched.

laat_vaar.voor: en nie elkeen het dit geken nie
laat_vaar.na: en nie almal het dit geken nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'nie almal nie' is the more natural Afrikaans for 'not everyone'; the meaning stays the same.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'nie elkeen het dit geken nie' is already natural Afrikaans, so swapping it for 'almal' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: Uit Mapungubwe kom daar ook ander goue voorwerpe.
laat_vaar.na: Daar kom ook ander goue voorwerpe uit Mapungubwe.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Starting with 'Uit Mapungubwe' plus 'daar' reads wooden; the plain order flows better.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Opening with 'Uit Mapungubwe' reads naturally and ties back to the place, so the reorder only reads differently.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat die renoster vir ons sê
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'self' emphasises the rhino, so it belongs straight after the noun; after the verb it reads like 'by itself'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Putting emphatic 'self' after the finite verb is normal Afrikaans and does not read as 'by itself', so moving it is a lateral move.
